title: .factory/config.yaml
description: A target repo's overlay on the central policy (spec §7, §8.1). It may add or tighten protected paths, add egress_extra hosts, lower budgets (including repo_monthly_usd) and run limits (including max_auto_rounds, disk.gb and the phase round counts, turns and cap), harden enforcement modes (budgets.enforcement, including poller, and runs.disk.enforcement), switch a run phase on, and set the repo's default_risk, workflow and sidecar, which are repo settings rather than policy. Any other key is rejected, daily_usd, poll_interval_s, repos and sidecars included. Loosening is caught by applyOverlay, which needs the base policy to compare against.

protected_paths.description: Repo-relative glob -> the modes to tighten. For a glob in the base policy, unnamed modes keep the base value. A new glob may name only ask or deny (applyOverlay rejects allow), and its unnamed modes add no rule. A file's mode is the strictest across every glob that matches it, so a new glob never loosens another. null means removal, which applyOverlay always rejects.

egress_extra.description: Hosts added to the archon zone's allowlist. Never a forge host.

budgets.description: Budgets to lower and enforcement modes to harden. Each value must be at most the base value. daily_usd is central only.

enforcement.description: Enforcement modes to harden: soft may become hard, never the reverse.

runs.description: Run limits to lower and phases to switch on. Each number must be at most the base value; a phase may not go from on to off, and disk.enforcement may only harden. poll_interval_s is central only.

disk.description: Lower gb; harden enforcement (soft may become hard).

phases.description: Switch a phase on (true; applyOverlay refuses false) and lower the round counts, turns and cap.

default_risk.description: The risk new work orders for this repo start from (spec §7). A repo setting, not policy: tighten-only doesn't apply. applyOverlay exposes it as repo.default_risk.

workflow.description: The Archon workflow this repo's work orders use by default (spec §7), a slug like a work order's workflow. A repo setting, not policy: tighten-only doesn't apply. applyOverlay exposes it as repo.workflow.

sidecar.description: The sidecar this repo's runs start (a name policy/sidecars.yaml lists) and the repo directory mounted into it, which is protected from workers. A repo setting, not policy: applyOverlay exposes it as repo.sidecar.

data_dir.description: A repo-relative directory, with no wildcard.
